notes.title: PRE:ONE has been totally renewed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/ab664a84de88c8cbedab16bf23ee038e831b9206.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]PRE:ONE Patch note[/h1][/b]

[b][h1]We have supplemented and improved the established parts which were uncomprotable.[/h1][/b]
[b]And also design has been changed from many parts and we have reflected the feedbacks of users.  The below is the contents of this patch
[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/f6ff95d2e5bd6218439702658c3944dd1282e99c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/07e002568be9536a07b916a05cae4f492b3b879e.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]1.Game designs are changed all round [/b][/h1]
    and almost of anything is changed in game
[b][h1]2.Game balance has been changed newly[/h1][/b]
[b][h1]3.Now when you use 'normal fire mode' then it would has strong shot spread,[/h1][/b] but you can reduce it with 'aimed fire mode'.
    Before this patch between 'normal fire' and 'aimed fire', there was no difference.
[b][h1]04. Now you are available to skip all cut scenes with 'Space bar'[/h1][/b]
[b][h1]5. All weapon designs are changed[/h1][/b]
  and some weapon designs that aren't suited for the background also are changed
[b][h1]7. we have sloved the stuck situation while playing.   [/h1][/b]
[b][h1]8. Unlike before, now enemies will come out with various ways and some fixed enemies are added too.[/h1][/b]
  and enemies will break the doors or take flying objects to kill you
[b][h1]9. UI design has been changed[/h1][/b]

[b][h1]10. New DLC of PRE:ONE is updated.[/h1][/b]
This DLC is about REVO the explorer and villain of PRE:ONE that why he has returned as a enemy
and it supplements the story of PRE:ONE

notes.title: Overall difficulty and functional convenience patch will be progressed of PRE:ONE
PRE:ONE//PRESTIGE Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/382677aac64bd97e6635df6d686dffc2cd9a92c2.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/bf1f871a785ede7a0dc09b196fe9436420a9108c.jpg[/img]

[h1]PRE:ONE is updated to the 'PRESTIGE' version![/h1]
with this patch almost of everything is changed and also game systems either

[b][h1]01. new character design[/h1]
from enemy NPCs to backgrounds, almost of everything is changed newly
prior poor designs and complicated backgrounds are also changed to be simple and practical

[h1]02. improvement of inconveniences[/h1]
i totally remodeled to the level design for fixing the problems of stucking with objects while moving

[h1]03. new systems [/h1]
i added new function of CAM that you can identify enemy's information before it appears
and also special weapone 'module' is added you can use this weapone with Q button
and now enemy has their roles they will attack the player with various ways


[h1]04. changes of keyboard setting [/h1]
melee combat key is changed as 'F' and you can use flashlight with 'G' now.
and also you can change weapones with numberkey 1~4
one more thing! by gaining module you can get the special weapones! 
you can use this with 'Q' button
and different from before, i gave markers to the NPCs for more easier distinguish of enemies	[/b]

notes.title: PRE:ONE 2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/77f9f662e30a046ae809251c85c60393fc7080bc.png[/img]

PRE: ONE fixes previous inconveniences and presents you with a new version!
New start screen theme, higher action, optimization, and animation scene.
Improved the first person screen of the game and improved the hitting feeling when attacking the enemy.
The design of the enemy has been much more detailed than before, and the difficulty of the enemy has been adjusted.
This PRE: ONE 2.0 update focused on improving perfection rather than new content.

[h1]Changes [/h1]-

1. The overall game has been improved
2. Several bugs have been fixed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/ef5c15c94927dbda6b4bd33d9cca5ef297d06b30.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/b59eb583f61cf8ea523d98a2eedc0cf32fb48f8c.png[/img]

3. Now you can see the character's lower body and the first person's feeling is more realistic

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/74f89b8c2fe96a5fad91107bd313d97048c22e57.png[/img]

4.Added the ability to tell the attack situation with the X mark when attacking the enemy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/48757ad023f8fa165ca9c5db0d96ec5b405af5d6.png[/img]

5. When the enemy is attacking you, it is displayed on the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/3c883c46fffc0cb837f802be727844ebe090cd4a.png[/img]

6.NEW START MENU SCREEN

https://youtu.be/UdU6XkQtwm8
7. Applying new physics sound

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32317765/49126d930fb66b748223092387e864bea562ea9a.png[/img]

8. The enemy NPC has been modified to lower the difficulty level and has greatly improved visuals
